# Ilvary Point

Site profile, revision 1.

Spare parts are held on site to keep repair times short during the winter months. Recycling partners have agreed to take back modules at the end of their service life. The developers published a lessons-learned report covering procurement and grid connection. Researchers caution against reading too much into a single season of operating data. A community fund receives a small share of the revenue from frequency regulation services.

## Key figures

- Technology: lithium iron phosphate

- Storage capacity: 238 MWh

- Round-trip efficiency: 84%

- Commissioned: 2032

Maintenance crews inspect the containment and the power electronics on a quarterly schedule. The site uses rainwater collection to supply its cooling loop during dry periods. Degradation is tracked with a monthly capacity test at a fixed state of charge. Operators report that availability improved after a firmware update to the inverters. The connection agreement limits export during summer evenings when the line is congested.
